swiftness.name: Verse of Swiftness
swiftness.text: +15 evade, +1 move. In a clash: +3 agility.

freeClimb.text: A Sage (Layra) hops from one high spot to another: her moves ignore height, and she flies over anyone in her way.

stone.name: Verse of Stone
stone.effectNote: Suleiman 30 Oct: the effect of the Verse of Stone is called Earth's Bulwark. Its short word is EARTH because BULWARK is already the Warden's signature.
stone.text: Earth's Bulwark, +2 defense. In a clash: +3 guard, harder to push.

stillGuard.text: A spearman (Gaha) who doesn't move on his turn plants his feet: half damage, and nothing can push him, until his next turn.

spiritBoltFire.name: Ember Bolt
spiritBoltFire.text: Kofi reads Fire: his Spirit Bolt sets the target alight, 2 damage a turn for 3 turns (never the last point; Herbs put it out).

spiritBoltWater.name: Tide Bolt
spiritBoltWater.text: Kofi reads Water: his Spirit Bolt leaves the target Drenched for 2 turns, so lightning hurts it more.

spiritBoltEarth.name: Stone Bolt
spiritBoltEarth.text: Kofi reads Earth: his Spirit Bolt knocks the target a tile back (into a wall, it slams).

spiritBoltStorm.name: Gale Bolt
spiritBoltStorm.text: Kofi reads Storm: his Spirit Bolt jumps to a second enemy within 2 tiles for half damage.

haunt.name: Haunt
haunt.text: A spirit mark: 2 damage at the start of each of the target's next 3 turns (never the last point; Herbs lift it). What Kofi reads adds to it. Fire: it also burns. Water: Drenched. Earth: bound, slower for 3 turns. Storm: shaken, its aim or trance breaks and it is Off-Balance.

infuse.name: Infuse
infuse.text: A blessing for an ally within 3 tiles, or himself, from what Kofi reads. Earth: the Stone Verse. Storm: Swiftness. Fire: Fury. Water: Renewal, +8 health and it lifts poison and burn. Ready again after 2 turns.

slow.name: Slow
slow.text: Its next turn comes later, and it is slower for 2 turns.

husk.name: Husk
husk.text: Leave a decoy that fools the enemy and slip up to 3 tiles away, even out of a clash. Enemies chase the decoy. If nobody strikes it by your next turn, it echoes your next spell: a second bolt of Lightning, or a Verse or Slow twice as strong. Cast under Swiftness, a struck decoy bursts in a howling gust: enemies next to it are blown 2 tiles away.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.text: Sink into a trance: your next turn is spent meditating too (you can't act), then 6 MP come back. You are Exposed until then, so keep allies close.

spearThrow.name: Spear Throw
spearThrow.text: Hurl the spear at an enemy up to 3 tiles away, 1 tile further for each level you stand above it. A hit knocks it back a tile (off a ledge, it falls; into a wall, it slams and is Disoriented). A higher block in the way stops the throw. Ready again after 3 turns.

herbs.name: Herbs
herbs.text: Throw a pouch of healing herbs to an ally up to 2 tiles away (one tile further for each level you stand above them), or use it yourself: +10 health, and it cures poison and puts out a burn. Ready again after 3 turns. Only 3 pouches a battle.

poisonArrow.name: Poison Arrow
poisonArrow.text: Take aim this turn; the arrow flies at the start of your next turn if the target is still within reach and in clear sight (a higher block in the way stops it). Half damage, then 3 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns. Poison never takes the last point of health, and Herbs cures it. Ready again after 3 turns.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.text: Charge up to 4 tiles at an enemy and slam it with the shield: half damage, and it's locked in a clash with you. If it was clashing with an ally, you take over and the ally is free. Ready again after 3 turns.

shieldToss.name: Shield Toss
shieldToss.text: Hurl the shield at an enemy up to 3 tiles away (a higher block in the way stops it): half damage, and it is stunned for a turn. A stunned unit loses its next turn, can't dodge, and takes flank hits (+3 damage). Ready again after 3 turns.

doubleHit.name: Double Hit
doubleHit.text: Strike with both heads of the spear: two quick hits on an enemy next to you, each 60% of a normal hit, each rolled on its own. When Rabdul attacks, there is a 35% chance he strikes this way.

shieldRam.name: Shield Ram
shieldRam.text: Stone turns Intercept into this: charge up to 4 tiles and ram the enemy 2 tiles back, no clash. Into a wall, it slams and is Disoriented. 3 Verse MP.

furyCharge.name: Furious Charge
furyCharge.text: Fury turns Intercept into this: charge up to 4 tiles and hit with your full strength, no clash. 3 Verse MP.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.text: Swiftness turns Intercept into this: a charge too fast to answer. Half damage, and it is stunned for a turn, no clash. 3 Verse MP.

sonicJavelin.name: Sonic Javelin
sonicJavelin.text: Swiftness turns Spear Throw into this. Up close: dash in and whirl the spear down. Further (5 tiles): a throw that hits every enemy in its line, through high blocks. At a reeling foe: zip to it and sweep low (1.5x damage). Never misses. 3 Verse MP.

furyDive.name: Fury Dive
furyDive.text: Fury turns Spear Throw into this: leap up to 3 tiles, over heads and walls, and slam down on an enemy for 1.5x a normal blow. Enemies next to where he lands are knocked Off-Balance. Never misses. 3 Verse MP.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.text: Stone turns her Lightning into this: the bolt knocks the target a tile back (into a wall, it slams). It still jumps to a second enemy.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.text: Fury turns her Lightning to fire: it sets the target alight, 2 damage a turn for 3 turns (never the last point; Herbs put it out). Fire doesn't jump.

enchant.name: Enchant
enchant.note: Roadmap 4.1 (Suleiman OK'd): Shango's symbol set on a weapon. Rabdul has 9 MP, so three casts a battle.
enchant.text: Rabdul calls on Shango and sets his symbol on a weapon: his own, or an ally's up to 3 tiles away. For its next 3 turns that weapon burns: +2 damage on every hit (+1 against a Drenched target, the water dulls the flames). Costs 3 MP. Ready again after 3 turns.

earthDrive.name: Earth Drive
earthDrive.note: Roadmap 4.2 (proposal built as proposed): half damage, push 1, the spike lasts 2 of Tayo's turns.
earthDrive.text: Tayo drives his fist into the ground and a spike of rock bursts up under the foe in front of him: half damage, and it is thrown back a tile (into a wall or a unit: a slam). The spike stays as a wall for 2 of his turns: nobody walks through it and it stops arrows and thrown weapons. Ready again after 3 turns.

clap.name: Sonic Burst
clap.note: Roadmap 13.31 (Baiyee 8 Nov, Suleiman agreed, no more long range): an area around Tayo, not a line. Every foe within 2 tiles takes a little damage (30 percent of a hit) and is knocked back 1 tile with the usual push rules (a wall or a unit behind it: a slam). The AI claps when 2 or more foes are within 2 tiles. Drawn with his attack pictures until Suleiman sends his Sonic Burst art (ART10). Renamed from Sonic Clap on 13 Nov (roadmap 13.37); the id stays "clap".
clap.text: Tayo claps his hands with all his might. A shockwave blasts every foe within 2 tiles: a little damage, and each is knocked back a tile (into a wall or a unit: a slam). Combo: any Earth Drive rock of his within 2 tiles bursts, and each foe next to a burst rock takes 4 more. Ready again after 3 turns.

elementBlast.name: Element Blast
elementBlast.note: Roadmap 13.4 (Suleiman's 6 Nov art, 13.17): only while an element is on him. Enchanted = fire (sets Burn, burn and turns as Wildfire), Drenched = water (leaves the target Drenched, puts out a burn). Spends the element. A straight line, range 3, full damage, a block in the way stops it like an arrow.
elementBlast.text: Tayo gathers the element on him into one fist and fires it down a straight line, up to 3 tiles (a higher block in the way stops it). Full damage. Enchanted: a fire blast that sets the target Burning. Drenched: a water blast that leaves the target Drenched. It spends the element (the Enchant ends, or he dries off), so it only works while one is on him. Ready again after 3 turns.

smokeBomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smokeBomb.text: Throw a smoke bomb at your own feet. Enemies next to you are Blinded for 1 turn (their attacks mostly miss, and they cannot start a clash or take aim). Then slip up to 2 tiles away for free: you are Hidden for 1 turn, so enemies cannot target you. The cloud stays until your next turn. Ready again after 3 turns. Not during a clash.
